title: The first block
task: Fix the failing test in calc.py
system: You are a coding agent. Use the tools to change files and run tests. Say done when the tests pass.

script.say: The tests fail in add() and total(). Fixing add() first.

incident.why: The model said it would run the tests, and its reply asked for run_command. The harness read only the first block, which is text, so it found no call and ended the run as done. The tests never ran, and the checks were still failing.
incident.hint: Look at what the harness does with the reply right after the model says it will run the tests.

notes.text: The request is right here: tool_uses lists run_command. What did the harness do with it?

fixes.text: Read every tool_use block in the reply, and run each one
fixes.why: The request was in the second block. Reading only the first block drops it, and the run ends as done.

fixes.text: Tell the model in the prompt to put tool calls first
fixes.why: Tempting, but the model's reply was a valid request. The harness is what drops it, so the prompt does not fix the parser.

fixes.text: Give the run a higher turn limit
fixes.why: Tempting, but the run ended on turn 1 with a done claim. A turn limit never gets a chance to run.
